data.body:
[P2] Verify the complete deployed environment

The readback checks only the three `LMI_*` variables. A function with a changed `AWS_RETRY_MODE` or additional SDK configuration variables still passes verification, and `configuration_identity` produces the same digest because those variables are absent from its inputs. Behaviorally different deployments can therefore be reported as the same verified configuration. Compare the complete environment with the template's expected mapping, including `AWS_RETRY_MODE`; any supported extra variables should also be included in the configuration identity. Add environment-drift tests.
